name: Progress Button
description: A button that shows its work: water rises while it waits, fills with a check on success, and flashes camellia with a retry label on failure.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called on press by mouse, touch or keyboard. Return a promise to show the working, done and failed states; anything else leaves the button as it is.

props.name: children
props.description: The idle label, with an optional 16 pixel icon. The width is kept from the widest of this and the retry label, so it never jumps.

props.name: labels
props.type: { loading?: string; success?: string; error?: string }
props.description: loading and success are announced to screen readers while the spinner and the check show. error is the visible retry label after a failure, and is announced too.

props.name: successDuration
props.description: Milliseconds the full button and check stay before the water drains and the label returns.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button except onPress. The button sets aria-busy while it works.
